entities.name: ZapD
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Shewanella oneidensis ZapD UniProt Q8EJQ0; 244 aa and 100% identity/coverage.
ZapD enhances FtsZ-ring assembly, interacts with FtsZ, bundles FtsZ protofilaments, and reduces FtsZ GTPase activity.
Predicted cytoplasmic protein that localizes to mid-cell in an FtsZ-dependent manner.
Contains the ZapD Pfam domain PF07072.17 at positions 18–222.
No explicit catalytic reaction was retrieved, supporting a structural/regulatory rather than enzymatic role.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular mass about 28.7 kDa; theoretical pI 7.12.
